replication.target_description: Assigned heritage-language-versus-foreign-language EIT comparison is explicitly excluded from this replication, which sampled foreign-language learners only. This is a known design mismatch, not an unavailable paper.

notes: Identity assessment: supplied source begins with OSF download provenance, title USING ELICITED IMITATION TO MEASURE GLOBAL ORAL PROFICIENCY IN SLA RESEARCH: A CLOSE REPLICATION STUDY, and authors Kevin McManus and Yingying Liu. It is labelled Preprint version, Language Teaching, accepted for publication 19 March 2020. Title, authors, journal, year and original-study identity match the neutral replication reference. Full primary research report with methods, results, references and appendices; not an abstract or secondary report. DOI is not printed in this candidate, so DOI identity is not independently confirmed. No PDF was supplied. Unassigned sides/fields are null placeholders only; not re-extracted. The source explicitly omits the heritage-background comparison; no analytic N, effect, p or authors’ replication-success verdict exists for that assigned contrast. The general supportive conclusion for foreign-language proficiency comparisons is not a success verdict on the excluded heritage contrast. Generic N=65 and EIT–oral-narrative r values concern other analyses.
